name: b02-bounded-select
purpose: Approved SELECT returns evidence and bounded results

given.text: alias "alpha" points at a disposable SQL Server fixture, scoped to dbo.Orders, through a read-only principal

when.text: Claude Code calls sql_execute on "alpha" with: SELECT OrderId FROM dbo.Orders

then.text: the result carries a query id
the result carries the exact SQL that ran
the result stays within the row and byte budget
the result says whether it was truncated
